subject: C32
required_fixes: R1 — apps/desktop/src/v2/harness/harness.tsx:78-88; apps/desktop/src/v2/store.ts:56: drafts are keyed by selected.reference, an authority epoch rather than the stable workspace ID. Rust retires that reference on tenant changes and issues a new one on restoration (authority/gateway_domain.rs:160-164, 241-255, 309-320), so a real tenant/workspace round trip makes the draft unreachable. The retained test at harness.test.tsx:394 reuses the old reference and misses this. Also, the fresh-composer selection lives only in component state: navigating away and back while drafting a new investigation switches to the existing conversation's empty composer. Acceptance: preserve each draft and its recoverable composer selection across navigation and A/B/A with newly issued context/workspace references, without sharing drafts or reviving execution authority.

R2 — apps/desktop/src/v2/harness/harness.tsx:138-167, 424: the startup continuation handles failed startup but not an ended startup. Send a first message, End conversation while it is starting, then observe that same operation ended: queued remains set, the note still says Starting a conversation, and Send stays disabled even after New investigation. A replacement ready conversation clears queued but hides the message in NEXT while falsely saying it is still in the box. Acceptance: cancellation/end/replacement retire the continuation, expose the exact recoverable text and leave usable controls; tests must cover End before ready, replacement, and unconfirmed admission without sending to an unrelated conversation or replaying automatically.

R3 — apps/desktop/src/v2/harness/harness.tsx:160-175, 407-415: the textarea remains editable during startup and delivery, but successful admission unconditionally clears its draft. Reproduced: submit Submitted question, type A later edit while startup waits, then make the admitted conversation ready; only Submitted question is sent and A later edit is erased. Acceptance: clear only the submitted draft revision or explicitly prevent editing during that interval; preserve subsequent edits across both first-send and existing-conversation admission, with regression tests.

R4 — apps/desktop/src/v2/harness/harness.tsx:113-119, 330-333; apps/desktop/src/v2/harness/copy.ts: confirmWriteNote: a returned unsent message is restored only if the conversation's draft is empty. If the operator has typed another draft while renewal waits, the original message is neither displayed nor offered for recovery, yet the alert claims it is back in the box. Clearing the draft does not rerun the restoration effect. Preserve both texts and provide explicit recovery without resending. Also remove the misleading keep-it-read-only alternative from confirmWriteNote: Not now returns the job without changing project access or restarting. Acceptance: renewal failure and declined write renewal with an existing draft keep both exact messages accessible, make truthful status claims, and send nothing automatically.
